name: Cursed Tank Simulator【HOLD THE LINE】
desc:
Create your very own cursed tanks by mixing and matching modules and fight with other players!

We aim to have NO Pay To Win elements.

A silly passion project made with love by a small team during our free time.

ROBLOX PREMIUM BENEFITS include 50% more 💴, XP, and crate rewards!

MOBILE/TABLET SUPPORT! (High spec needed! Year 2022 onwards)

Press K in the garage to change the weather
Press F1 in game or tap "HELP" for help with controls or game mechanics!

⚠️ Exploiting the game or its mechanics will result in moderation ⚠️

THIS GAME IS NOT MEANT TO BE REALISTIC! THIS IS NOT WARTHUNDER!!!
Enjoy :D
